title: UniFi Protect Smart Detection by Zone
app: Reolink, UniFi Protect, Ring, Nest Protect, Frigate, and Home Assistant security integrations streamed to Splunk HEC via MQTT, webhooks, and vendor APIs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=unifiprotect:event event=smart_detect
| bin _time span=1w
| stats count as detections by zone object_type _time
| sort - detections
description: Uses UniFi Protect smart detections telemetry to monitor weekly object-detection volume by camera zone in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for zones that are busy enough to need tighter rules or better filters, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest UniFi Protect smart detections data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a hourly cadence.
visualization: Weekly zone and object-type detection leaderboard.
grandmaExplanation: It reminds weekly object-detection volume by camera zone so you can spot zones that are busy enough to need tighter rules or better filters before it becomes annoying.
